_about: G4 brand policy delta for customer follow-up and booking messages (D-17). Seeded into G0 through its own loader as policy version g4-followup-1; every customer message must pass G0 policy v1 (unchanged, not copied) AND this version. Rules are home-service tone rules that G0 v1 does not hold.
source: g4-intake-desk docs/prd.md (brand.policy: tone for follow-up messages); D-17
text: Customer messages from a home-services business: plain, calm and short. Say what happens next and who will contact them. Never quote a price or a fee in a message; prices come from a person. Never promise an arrival time or guarantee an outcome. Texts stay under 60 words.

rules.fix: Remove the price; say a team member will go over pricing.
Do not promise outcomes or arrival times; say what happens next.
Do not commit to an arrival window in writing; the dispatcher confirms times.
No pressure language in customer messages.
